branch.new_sub: A branch is a folder in the forest: it holds documents and other branches, and its summary is how a search knows what is inside.
branch.parent_hint: The branch it goes under. Only branches you can reach are listed.
branch.name: Name
branch.name_hint: Letters and digits. It becomes the folder name.
branch.will_be: Will be created as {id} — permanently. Ids never change.
branch.summary_placeholder: Signed client contracts, by year, with their amendments and termination notices.
branch.summary_hint: One to three sentences ({n}/60 tokens). Every later search reads this to decide whether to come in.
branch.summary_long: Too long — the forest keeps summaries under 60 tokens.
